-- CP11 schema change demo, step 3: control (G2 detect, G3 react) and serving views.
-- Rerun after 71 to re-seed the contract. The alert is created suspended; 78_start.sql resumes it.

create schema if not exists {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL comment = 'G2/G3: contract, drift, freshness, DT health, guard';
create schema if not exists {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING comment = 'Read-only views for the app';

-- ---------- G2: the L0 contract (what L1 relies on) ----------
create or replace table {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.L0_CONTRACT (
  TABLE_NAME varchar, COLUMN_NAME varchar, TYPE_SQL varchar, ORDINAL_POSITION number,
  L1_COLUMN varchar,              -- business name in guarded L1, null when L1 does not use it
  STATUS varchar default 'ACTIVE' -- ACTIVE | DEPRECATED (removed upstream, absorbed in L1) | ADOPTED (added later)
);
insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.L0_CONTRACT (TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, TYPE_SQL, ORDINAL_POSITION, L1_COLUMN)
select c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME, c.TYPE_SQL, c.ORDINAL_POSITION, m.L1_COLUMN
from {{DEMO_L0}}.SYNC.V_COLS c
left join (select column1 as T, column2 as C, column3 as L1_COLUMN from values
    ('EQUIPMENT', 'EQUIPMENT', 'EQUIPMENT_ID'), ('EQUIPMENT', 'EQUIPMENTNAME', 'EQUIPMENT_NAME'),
    ('EQUIPMENT', 'PLANT', 'SITE'), ('EQUIPMENT', 'FLEETTYPE', 'FLEET_TYPE'),
    ('MAINT_NOTIFICATION', 'MAINTENANCENOTIFICATION', 'NOTIFICATION_ID'), ('MAINT_NOTIFICATION', 'EQUIPMENT', 'EQUIPMENT_ID'),
    ('MAINT_NOTIFICATION', 'NOTIFICATIONTYPE', 'NOTIFICATION_TYPE'), ('MAINT_NOTIFICATION', 'PRIORITY', 'PRIORITY'),
    ('MAINT_NOTIFICATION', 'CREATEDON', 'CREATED_ON'), ('MAINT_NOTIFICATION', 'DOWNTIMEHOURS', 'DOWNTIME_HOURS')) m
  on m.T = c.TABLE_NAME and m.C = c.COLUMN_NAME
where c.TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MAINTENANCE';

-- ---------- G2: drift = contract vs live metadata of the CLD stand-in ----------
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_SCHEMA_DRIFT
  comment = 'G2: differences between the L0 contract and the live CLD columns'
as
with live as (select TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, TYPE_SQL from {{DEMO_L0}}.SYNC.V_COLS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MAINTENANCE'),
live_tables as (select distinct TABLE_NAME from live),
d as (
  select coalesce(c.TABLE_NAME, l.TABLE_NAME) as TABLE_NAME,
         coalesce(c.COLUMN_NAME, l.COLUMN_NAME) as COLUMN_NAME,
         c.TYPE_SQL as CONTRACT_TYPE, l.TYPE_SQL as LIVE_TYPE, c.L1_COLUMN, c.STATUS,
         case when c.COLUMN_NAME is null then 'COLUMN_ADDED'
              when l.COLUMN_NAME is null and t.TABLE_NAME is null then 'TABLE_REMOVED'
              when l.COLUMN_NAME is null then 'COLUMN_REMOVED'
              when c.TYPE_SQL <> l.TYPE_SQL then 'TYPE_CHANGED' end as CHANGE
  from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.L0_CONTRACT c
  full outer join live l on l.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME and l.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME
  left join live_tables t on t.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME
)
select TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, CHANGE, CONTRACT_TYPE, LIVE_TYPE, L1_COLUMN,
       case when CHANGE = 'COLUMN_ADDED' then 'INFO'
            when STATUS = 'DEPRECATED' then 'INFO'
            when L1_COLUMN is null then 'WARNING'
            when CHANGE = 'TYPE_CHANGED' then 'WARNING'
            else 'BREAKING' end as SEVERITY,
       case when CHANGE = 'COLUMN_ADDED' then 'New SAP column, not used by L1 yet (not adopted)'
            when STATUS = 'DEPRECATED' then 'Removed upstream; absorbed in L1 (column kept as null)'
            when L1_COLUMN is null then 'Not used by L1; only L0 objects that name it are affected'
            when CHANGE = 'TYPE_CHANGED' then 'Type changed; the L1 cast to ' || CONTRACT_TYPE || ' keeps L2 stable'
            else 'L1 column ' || L1_COLUMN || ' depends on it: the L2 refresh would fail' end as NOTE
from d
where CHANGE is not null;

-- ---------- G2: freshness of the CLD sync ----------
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_L0_FRESHNESS
  comment = 'G2: when the CLD stand-in last synced, and rows published but not yet synced'
as
with rc as (select sum(iff(TABLE_SCHEMA = 'PUBLISHER', ROW_COUNT, 0)) as PUB_ROWS,
                   sum(iff(TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MAINTENANCE', ROW_COUNT, 0)) as CLD_ROWS
            from {{DEMO_L0}}.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
            where TABLE_SCHEMA in ('PUBLISHER', 'MAINTENANCE') and TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE')
select s.LAST_SYNC_AT, s.LAST_ACTIONS,
       datediff('second', s.LAST_SYNC_AT, current_timestamp()) / 60 as MINUTES_SINCE_SYNC,
       greatest(coalesce(rc.PUB_ROWS, 0) - coalesce(rc.CLD_ROWS, 0), 0) as ROWS_WAITING,
       2 as THRESHOLD_MINUTES,
       iff(s.LAST_SYNC_AT is null or datediff('second', s.LAST_SYNC_AT, current_timestamp()) > 120, 'BREACH', 'FRESH') as STATUS
from {{DEMO_L0}}.SYNC.L0_SYNC_STATE s cross join rc;

-- ---------- G3: DT health for both pipelines ----------
-- INFORMATION_SCHEMA reads cost seconds each (DYNAMIC_TABLES() 5-17 s), too slow for a page that polls.
-- SP_STATUS_SNAPSHOT takes SHOW DYNAMIC TABLES (about 1 s) into DT_STATE, and snapshots drift, DT health and
-- rows waiting into small SNAP_* tables. STATUS_SNAPSHOT_TASK runs it every minute while the demo runs, and
-- the guard runs it after every action. The guard itself always reads the live views.
create or replace table {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.DT_STATE (SCHEMA_NAME varchar, NAME varchar, STATE varchar,
  DATA_TIMESTAMP timestamp_ltz, TARGET_LAG varchar, CREATED_ON timestamp_ltz, TAKEN_AT timestamp_ltz);

create or replace procedure {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_STATUS_SNAPSHOT()
returns varchar
language sql
execute as caller  -- reads INFORMATION_SCHEMA refresh history
as
$$
begin
  show dynamic tables in database {{DEMO_DB}};
  create or replace table {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.DT_STATE as
  select "schema_name"::varchar as SCHEMA_NAME, "name"::varchar as NAME, "scheduling_state"::varchar as STATE,
         "data_timestamp"::timestamp_ltz as DATA_TIMESTAMP, "target_lag"::varchar as TARGET_LAG,
         "created_on"::timestamp_ltz as CREATED_ON, current_timestamp() as TAKEN_AT
  from table(result_scan(last_query_id()));
  create or replace table {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DT_HEALTH as select * from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_DT_HEALTH;
  create or replace table {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DRIFT as select *, current_timestamp() as TAKEN_AT from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_SCHEMA_DRIFT;
  create or replace table {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_L0 as select ROWS_WAITING, current_timestamp() as TAKEN_AT from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_L0_FRESHNESS;
  return 'Status snapshot taken';
end;
$$;

create or replace task {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.STATUS_SNAPSHOT_TASK
  schedule = '1 minute'
  user_task_managed_initial_warehouse_size = 'XSMALL'
  comment = 'CP11: status snapshot for the app (DT state, drift, DT health, rows waiting)'
as call {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_STATUS_SNAPSHOT();

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_DT_HEALTH
  comment = 'G3: state, data as of and recent refresh outcome of every demo Dynamic Table'
as
with h as (
  -- Default RESULT_LIMIT is 100 rows; restores re-create the DTs under the same names, so keep only
  -- refreshes of the current instance (after its CREATED_ON)
  select r.NAME, r.SCHEMA_NAME, r.STATE, r.STATE_MESSAGE, r.REFRESH_ACTION, r.REFRESH_START_TIME,
         row_number() over (partition by r.SCHEMA_NAME, r.NAME order by r.REFRESH_START_TIME desc nulls last) as RN
  from table({{DEMO_DB}}.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.DYNAMIC_TABLE_REFRESH_HISTORY(
         DATA_TIMESTAMP_START => dateadd('minute', -60, current_timestamp()), RESULT_LIMIT => 10000, NAME_PREFIX => '{{DEMO_DB}}.')) r
  join {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.DT_STATE s on s.SCHEMA_NAME = r.SCHEMA_NAME and s.NAME = r.NAME
  where r.REFRESH_START_TIME >= s.CREATED_ON and r.STATE not in ('SCHEDULED', 'EXECUTING')
),
agg as (
  select SCHEMA_NAME, NAME,
         count_if(STATE = 'FAILED') as FAILED_60M,
         count_if(STATE = 'UPSTREAM_FAILED') as UPSTREAM_FAILED_60M,
         max(iff(RN = 1, STATE, null)) as LAST_STATE,
         max(iff(RN = 1, REFRESH_ACTION, null)) as LAST_ACTION,
         max_by(iff(STATE in ('FAILED', 'UPSTREAM_FAILED'), STATE_MESSAGE, null), iff(STATE in ('FAILED', 'UPSTREAM_FAILED'), REFRESH_START_TIME, null)) as LAST_ERROR
  from h group by 1, 2
)
select iff(d.SCHEMA_NAME = 'NAIVE', 'UNGUARDED', 'GUARDED') as PIPELINE,
       iff(d.NAME = 'DT_SITE_SUMMARY', 2, 1) as TIER,
       d.SCHEMA_NAME, d.NAME, '{{DEMO_DB}}.' || d.SCHEMA_NAME || '.' || d.NAME as QUALIFIED_NAME,
       d.STATE,
       iff(d.STATE = 'SUSPENDED', 'Suspended; serving the last good refresh', null) as STATE_REASON,
       d.DATA_TIMESTAMP as DATA_AS_OF,
       round(datediff('second', d.DATA_TIMESTAMP, current_timestamp()) / 60, 1) as MINUTES_BEHIND,
       try_to_number(split_part(d.TARGET_LAG, ' ', 1)) as TARGET_LAG_MIN,
       a.LAST_STATE as LAST_REFRESH_STATE,
       a.LAST_ACTION as LAST_REFRESH_ACTION,
       coalesce(a.FAILED_60M, 0) as FAILED_60M, coalesce(a.UPSTREAM_FAILED_60M, 0) as UPSTREAM_FAILED_60M,
       a.LAST_ERROR,
       d.TAKEN_AT as STATE_TAKEN_AT
from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.DT_STATE d
left join agg a on a.SCHEMA_NAME = d.SCHEMA_NAME and a.NAME = d.NAME
where d.SCHEMA_NAME in ('L2', 'NAIVE') and d.NAME not like '%\\_V2';

-- ---------- Audit trail of every scenario, finding, guard action and fix ----------
create or replace table {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (
  EVENT_AT timestamp_ltz default current_timestamp(),
  SCENARIO varchar,      -- 73a..73f, 74b.., BASELINE
  EVENT varchar,         -- SCENARIO_RUN | DRIFT_DETECTED | FRESHNESS_BREACH | AUTO_SUSPEND | FIX_APPLIED | RESUMED | STARTED | RESTORED
  GUARDRAIL varchar,     -- G1..G4
  DETAIL varchar,
  SOURCE varchar,        -- PRESENTER | ALERT_SCHEMA_GUARD
  FINDING_KEY varchar
);

-- Findings not yet logged since the demo was last started or restored
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_GUARD_NEW_FINDINGS as
with since as (select coalesce(max(EVENT_AT), '1970-01-01'::timestamp_ltz) as TS
               from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG where EVENT in ('STARTED', 'RESTORED')),
f as (
  select CHANGE || ':' || TABLE_NAME || '.' || COLUMN_NAME || ':' || SEVERITY as FINDING_KEY,
         'DRIFT_DETECTED' as EVENT, iff(SEVERITY = 'BREAKING', 'G2', iff(CHANGE = 'TYPE_CHANGED', 'G1', 'G2')) as GUARDRAIL,
         SEVERITY || ' ' || CHANGE || ' ' || TABLE_NAME || '.' || COLUMN_NAME || ': ' || NOTE as DETAIL
  from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_SCHEMA_DRIFT
  union all
  select 'FRESHNESS_BREACH:' || coalesce(to_varchar(LAST_SYNC_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'NEVER'),
         'FRESHNESS_BREACH', 'G2',
         'L0 not synced for ' || coalesce(to_varchar(floor(MINUTES_SINCE_SYNC)), '?') || ' min (threshold ' || THRESHOLD_MINUTES || '); '
           || ROWS_WAITING || ' published rows waiting. DTs still report success on stale data.'
  from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_L0_FRESHNESS where STATUS = 'BREACH'
)
select f.* from f
where f.FINDING_KEY not in (select FINDING_KEY from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG, since
                            where FINDING_KEY is not null and EVENT_AT >= since.TS);

-- ---------- Real SAP BDC CLDs (read-only): column drift since the CP11 baseline ----------
create table if not exists {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_BASELINE (CLD varchar, TABLE_SCHEMA varchar, TABLE_NAME varchar, COLUMN_NAME varchar, DATA_TYPE varchar, TAKEN_AT timestamp_ltz);
create table if not exists {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_NOW (CLD varchar, TABLE_SCHEMA varchar, TABLE_NAME varchar, COLUMN_NAME varchar, DATA_TYPE varchar, TAKEN_AT timestamp_ltz);
-- Link status (SYSTEM$CATALOG_LINK_STATUS) cannot be called from a procedure or view, and needs a
-- constant argument; the app server reads it directly per CLD (routes/schemachange.ts).

create or replace procedure {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_REAL_CLD_SNAPSHOT(MODE varchar)
returns varchar
language sql
execute as owner
as
$$
declare
  c1 cursor for select distinct CLD from {{DATABASE}}.CORE.L0_SOURCES order by 1;
  q varchar;
  n number default 0;
  target varchar;
begin
  -- The baseline is taken once and kept across demo restores
  if (:MODE = 'BASELINE' and (select count(*) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_BASELINE) > 0) then
    return 'BASELINE kept (taken earlier)';
  end if;
  target := iff(:MODE = 'BASELINE', '{{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_BASELINE', '{{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_NOW');
  q := 'truncate table ' || target;
  execute immediate :q;
  for r in c1 do
    q := 'insert into ' || target || ' select ''' || r.CLD || ''', c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME, c.DATA_TYPE, current_timestamp() '
      || 'from "' || r.CLD || '".INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c join {{DATABASE}}.CORE.L0_SOURCES s '
      || 'on s.CLD = ''' || r.CLD || ''' and s.SOURCE_SCHEMA = c.TABLE_SCHEMA and s.SOURCE_TABLE = c.TABLE_NAME';
    execute immediate :q;
    n := n + 1;
  end for;
  return :MODE || ': ' || n || ' CLDs';
end;
$$;

call {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_REAL_CLD_SNAPSHOT('BASELINE');
call {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_REAL_CLD_SNAPSHOT('CHECK');

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_REAL_CLD_HEALTH
  comment = 'Real SAP BDC CLDs used by MINING_360 L0: link status and column drift since the CP11 baseline (read-only)'
as
with b as (select CLD, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_BASELINE),
     n as (select CLD, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_NOW),
     d as (
  select coalesce(b.CLD, n.CLD) as CLD,
         count_if(b.COLUMN_NAME is null) as COLUMNS_ADDED,
         count_if(n.COLUMN_NAME is null) as COLUMNS_REMOVED,
         count_if(b.DATA_TYPE <> n.DATA_TYPE) as TYPES_CHANGED,
         count(distinct coalesce(n.TABLE_NAME, b.TABLE_NAME)) as TABLES,
         count(n.COLUMN_NAME) as COLUMNS_NOW
  from b full outer join n on n.CLD = b.CLD and n.TABLE_SCHEMA = b.TABLE_SCHEMA and n.TABLE_NAME = b.TABLE_NAME and n.COLUMN_NAME = b.COLUMN_NAME
  group by 1)
select d.CLD, d.TABLES, d.COLUMNS_NOW, d.COLUMNS_ADDED, d.COLUMNS_REMOVED, d.TYPES_CHANGED,
       (select min(TAKEN_AT) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_BASELINE) as BASELINE_AT,
       (select max(TAKEN_AT) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_NOW) as CHECKED_AT,
       case when d.COLUMNS_REMOVED + d.TYPES_CHANGED > 0 then 'BREAKING'
            when d.COLUMNS_ADDED > 0 then 'INFO' else 'OK' end as STATUS
from d;

-- ---------- G3: the guard. Logs findings; suspends the guarded L2 DT on BREAKING drift ----------
create or replace procedure {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_SCHEMA_GUARD()
returns varchar
language sql
execute as caller  -- reads INFORMATION_SCHEMA refresh history
as
$$
declare
  logged number;
  breaking number;
  active number;
  real_age number;
begin
  -- Contain first (fast path: drift view + SHOW), log and snapshot after
  breaking := (select count(*) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_SCHEMA_DRIFT where SEVERITY = 'BREAKING');
  if (breaking > 0) then
    show dynamic tables like 'DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME' in schema {{DEMO_DB}}.L2;
    active := (select count(*) from table(result_scan(last_query_id())) where "scheduling_state" = 'ACTIVE');
    if (active > 0) then
      alter dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME suspend;
      insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
      values (null, 'AUTO_SUSPEND', 'G3',
              'BREAKING drift (' || :breaking || ') found: DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME suspended, users keep the last good snapshot',
              'ALERT_SCHEMA_GUARD');
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE, FINDING_KEY)
  select null, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, 'ALERT_SCHEMA_GUARD', FINDING_KEY from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_GUARD_NEW_FINDINGS;
  logged := SQLROWCOUNT;

  real_age := (select coalesce(datediff('minute', max(TAKEN_AT), current_timestamp()), 999) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.REAL_CLD_COLUMNS_NOW);
  if (real_age >= 10) then
    call {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_REAL_CLD_SNAPSHOT('CHECK');
  end if;
  call {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_STATUS_SNAPSHOT();
  return logged || ' findings logged; breaking ' || breaking || '; guarded DT suspended now ' || coalesce(active, 0);
end;
$$;

create or replace alert {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.ALERT_SCHEMA_GUARD
  warehouse = {{WAREHOUSE}}
  schedule = '1 minute'
  comment = 'CP11 G3: logs schema drift and freshness breaches; suspends the guarded L2 DT on BREAKING drift'
  if (exists (
    select 1 from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_GUARD_NEW_FINDINGS
    union all
    select 1 from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_SCHEMA_DRIFT
    where SEVERITY = 'BREAKING'
      and exists (select 1 from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.DT_STATE
                  where SCHEMA_NAME = 'L2' and NAME = 'DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME' and STATE = 'ACTIVE')))
  then call {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_SCHEMA_GUARD();

-- ---------- Serving views for the app (fast: snapshot tables plus live timestamps) ----------
call {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_STATUS_SNAPSHOT();

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_L0_FRESHNESS_FAST
  comment = 'V_L0_FRESHNESS for the app: live sync time, rows waiting from the last snapshot'
as select s.LAST_SYNC_AT, s.LAST_ACTIONS,
          datediff('second', s.LAST_SYNC_AT, current_timestamp()) / 60 as MINUTES_SINCE_SYNC,
          coalesce(w.ROWS_WAITING, 0) as ROWS_WAITING, 2 as THRESHOLD_MINUTES,
          iff(s.LAST_SYNC_AT is null or datediff('second', s.LAST_SYNC_AT, current_timestamp()) > 120, 'BREACH', 'FRESH') as STATUS
   from {{DEMO_L0}}.SYNC.L0_SYNC_STATE s
   left join {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_L0 w on true;
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_DOWNTIME
  comment = 'What users read: the guarded L2 DT (blue/green switch point for 74v2). Explicit columns (G1 also applies here)'
as select SITE, FLEET_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_NAME, MONTH, NOTIFICATIONS, DOWNTIME_HOURS
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME;

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_SITE_COMPARE
  comment = 'Downtime by site and month from both pipelines, side by side'
as select 'GUARDED' as PIPELINE, SITE, MONTH, NOTIFICATIONS, DOWNTIME_HOURS from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_SITE_SUMMARY
   union all
   select 'UNGUARDED', SITE, MONTH, NOTIFICATIONS, DOWNTIME_HOURS from {{DEMO_DB}}.NAIVE.DT_SITE_SUMMARY;

create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_DRIFT as select * exclude (TAKEN_AT) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DRIFT;
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_DT_HEALTH as
select * exclude (MINUTES_BEHIND), round(datediff('second', DATA_AS_OF, current_timestamp()) / 60, 1) as MINUTES_BEHIND
from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DT_HEALTH;
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_REAL_CLD_HEALTH as select * from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_REAL_CLD_HEALTH;
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_CHANGE_LOG as
select EVENT_AT, coalesce(SCENARIO, '') as SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE
from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG;

-- Layer status of the guarded pipeline, for the layer impact strip
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_LAYERS
  comment = 'Guarded pipeline: OK | CHANGED | STALE | CONTAINED | BROKEN | SNAPSHOT per layer'
as
with x as (
  select (select count(*) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DRIFT) as DRIFT,
         (select count(*) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DRIFT where SEVERITY = 'BREAKING') as BREAKING,
         (select STATUS from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_L0_FRESHNESS_FAST) as FRESH,
         (select max(STATE) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DT_HEALTH where PIPELINE = 'GUARDED' and TIER = 1) as DT_STATE,
         (select max(LAST_REFRESH_STATE) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DT_HEALTH where PIPELINE = 'GUARDED' and TIER = 1) as DT_LAST
),
s as (
  select iff(DRIFT > 0, 'CHANGED', iff(FRESH = 'BREACH', 'STALE', 'OK')) as L0,
         iff(BREAKING > 0, 'BROKEN', iff(DRIFT > 0, 'CONTAINED', 'OK')) as L1,
         case when DT_STATE = 'SUSPENDED' then 'CONTAINED'
              when DT_LAST in ('FAILED', 'UPSTREAM_FAILED') then 'BROKEN'
              when FRESH = 'BREACH' then 'STALE' else 'OK' end as L2
  from x
)
select 1 as ORD, 'L0' as LAYER, 'CLD (SAP data product)' as LABEL, L0 as STATUS from s
union all select 2, 'L1', 'Contract views', L1 from s
union all select 3, 'L2', 'Dynamic Tables', L2 from s
union all select 4, 'SERVING', 'Serving views', case L2 when 'OK' then 'OK' when 'STALE' then 'STALE' else 'SNAPSHOT' end from s
union all select 5, 'APP', 'App users', case L2 when 'OK' then 'OK' when 'STALE' then 'STALE' else 'SNAPSHOT' end from s;

-- One row: banner, current scenario key for the scenario-aware presenter note
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_STATUS as
with last_step as (
  select EVENT_AT, iff(EVENT in ('STARTED', 'RESTORED'), 'BASELINE', SCENARIO) as SCENARIO
  from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG
  where EVENT in ('SCENARIO_RUN', 'FIX_APPLIED', 'RESUMED', 'STARTED', 'RESTORED')
  qualify row_number() over (order by EVENT_AT desc) = 1
),
after as (
  select count_if(l.EVENT = 'AUTO_SUSPEND') as SUSPENDS, count_if(l.EVENT in ('DRIFT_DETECTED', 'FRESHNESS_BREACH')) as FINDINGS
  from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG l, last_step s where l.EVENT_AT >= s.EVENT_AT
),
drift as (select coalesce(count_if(SEVERITY = 'BREAKING'), 0) as BREAKING, coalesce(count_if(SEVERITY = 'WARNING'), 0) as WARNING,
                 coalesce(count_if(SEVERITY = 'INFO'), 0) as INFO from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DRIFT),
g as (select * from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DT_HEALTH where PIPELINE = 'GUARDED' and TIER = 1),
u as (select * from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_DT_HEALTH where PIPELINE = 'UNGUARDED' and TIER = 1),
mode as (select EVENT as LAST_MODE from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG where EVENT in ('STARTED', 'RESTORED')
         qualify row_number() over (order by EVENT_AT desc) = 1)
select coalesce(s.SCENARIO, 'BASELINE') as SCENARIO,
       coalesce(s.SCENARIO, 'BASELINE') || case when a.SUSPENDS > 0 then '_SUSPENDED' when a.FINDINGS > 0 then '_DETECTED' else '' end as CURRENT_SCENARIO,
       s.EVENT_AT as SCENARIO_AT,
       iff(m.LAST_MODE = 'STARTED', 'RUNNING', 'IDLE') as DEMO_STATE,
       d.BREAKING, d.WARNING, d.INFO,
       f.STATUS as FRESHNESS, f.MINUTES_SINCE_SYNC, f.LAST_SYNC_AT, f.ROWS_WAITING,
       g.STATE as GUARDED_STATE, g.DATA_AS_OF as GUARDED_DATA_AS_OF, g.LAST_REFRESH_STATE as GUARDED_LAST_REFRESH,
       u.STATE as UNGUARDED_STATE, u.DATA_AS_OF as UNGUARDED_DATA_AS_OF, u.LAST_REFRESH_STATE as UNGUARDED_LAST_REFRESH,
       (select max(TAKEN_AT) from {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SNAP_L0) as STATUS_TAKEN_AT,
       case when m.LAST_MODE is distinct from 'STARTED' then 'IDLE'
            when d.BREAKING + d.WARNING > 0 or f.STATUS = 'BREACH' or g.STATE = 'SUSPENDED' then 'WARNING'
            when d.INFO > 0 then 'INFO' else 'OK' end as BANNER
from drift d
cross join {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.V_L0_FRESHNESS_FAST f
left join last_step s on true
left join after a on true
left join g on true
left join u on true
left join mode m on true;

call {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SP_STATUS_SNAPSHOT();
